# The Africa Plug

The Africa Plug is a platform connecting Africa and the world through investment, business and entertainment. It publishes practical information, commercial opportunities and services for people exploring, entering and growing across African markets.

## Founder

FK is the founder of The Africa Plug and an Africa commercial deal consultant. She supports businesses navigating market entry, counterparties, regulatory approvals, negotiations and commercial decisions across Africa.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://theafricaplug.com/): Overview of The Africa Plug and its work.
- [About](https://theafricaplug.com/about): The platform, its focus and founder FK.
- [T.A.P IN](https://theafricaplug.com/tap-in): Business and investment opportunities across Africa.
- [Work With FK](https://theafricaplug.com/work-with-fk): Commercial deal consultancy and paid services.
- [Apply to work with FK](https://theafricaplug.com/work-with-fk/apply): Submit a brief for review for a Deal Diagnostic.
- [30-minute call with FK](https://theafricaplug.com/work-with-fk/call): Book a focused paid consultation.
- [The Store](https://theafricaplug.com/store): Guides and services, including the Pet Travel Consultation.
- [Blog](https://theafricaplug.com/blog): Articles on business, investment, culture and travel across Africa.
- [Contact](https://theafricaplug.com/contact): Contact The Africa Plug.
- [Privacy Policy](https://theafricaplug.com/privacy): How personal information is handled.
- [Refunds Policy](https://theafricaplug.com/refunds): Cancellation and refund terms.

## Services

- Deal Diagnostic with FK: £2,500.
- 30-minute call with FK: £350.
- Pet Travel Consultation: £95.

For current details, availability and terms, use the relevant page on the website. Do not assume that listings or third-party opportunities are endorsed or guaranteed by The Africa Plug.
